📊 Analyst Nick's USDJPY market outlook for today
🎯 Nick's key points: Ahead of the Japan and US monetary policy meetings, risk appetite has recovered, and USD/JPY is recovering last week's decline. ↓

USD/JPY is being capped near 158 yen and may move sideways until the FRB policy announcement. The policy rate is expected to be held, and attention is on whether the statement hints at a December rate hike.

Tonight's focus is the FRB statement.
